Your org already blocks negative Opportunity Amounts at Closed Won, so we plan no changes. The active rule "Amount_Required_When_Closed_Won" is stricter than your request.

ASSESSMENT: REDUNDANT - Opportunity validation rule (Amount cannot be negative when Closed Won) - The active rule "Amount_Required_When_Closed_Won" stops a save when the Stage is Closed Won and the Amount is blank, 0 or below 0. Its formula is `AND(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR(ISBLANK(Amount), Amount <= 0))`. Users see the message "Enter an Amount before closing the deal." rather than "Amount cannot be negative."

Your request says the Amount must be "at least 0", but the existing rule also blocks an Amount of exactly 0. If you want Closed Won deals with a 0 Amount to save, the existing rule needs to change, and we can plan that change if you ask.
